questions: In fully visible middle frames, are exactly three pens visible on the white carrier?
Does each pen show a visible black cap-like part at its lower end?
Does any pen show an exposed pointed writing tip where the black cap-like part should be?
Are the three pens parallel and similarly oriented on the carrier?
Does the carrier move smoothly from LEFT to RIGHT while the pens remain stable relative to it?

question_answers.evidence: From frame 00:05 onwards, three distinct pens are clearly visible on the white carrier plate.
All three pens display a black cap-like part (or grip) at their lower end in frames 00:05 through 00:12.
No pen shows an exposed pointed writing tip; all lower ends appear capped or have the standard black grip.
The three pens are arranged in a vertical, parallel row and maintain this orientation throughout the movement.
The carrier moves steadily from left to right, and the pens do not shift position relative to the plate.

parsed.reason: All three pens are fully visible in the middle frames and each exhibits the normal black cap-like part at the bottom. No missing cap anomaly is present.
